factorAttribution.insight: Quality had the highest average IC (+0.034, spread +1.1%/period). DCF averaged negative IC (-0.036) — adaptive weights should not increase that pillar when IC stays negative. Suggested blend vs effective ranking mix: Quality 12% → 12%.
